description: The image shows a wide, multi-lane roadway with no visible sidewalks or pedestrian path; the edges are defined by a concrete curb/barrier and red guardrail, so pedestrians would have to walk in/near the roadway. Traffic is separated from the shoulder by the continuous barrier, with tall streetlights along the median/roadway providing lighting, but there is little to no greenery or shade and no visible curb ramps or other accessibility features. The roadway appears smooth and well-marked, yet the lack of pedestrian infrastructure and separation makes it poorly walkable and potentially unsafe.
